Pilot the **Copper Busbar Paddle** to bounce an electron charge pulse through stages of passive **Resistors ($R$)**, **Capacitors ($C$)**, and **Inductors ($L$)**. Shatter **IC Gate (`GATE?`)** blocks to trigger real-time **Engineering Override** math challenges for bonus points and busbar expansions!
